subject: Community Project
project_title: GROW Community Project · Charity Cake Sale for Zoe's Place
title: Practise sale-day skills
objective_verbatim: Practise batch production or decoration/packaging, then rehearse customer service and cash handling using a mock stall. Students practise greeting, taking an order, giving change or recording a cashless sale.
lesson_objective: Practise one safe bench job, then greet, check an order and show change or a cashless tally at a mock stall.
success_criteria: I can get my food label checked.
I can show what I did.
I can greet and check an order.
I can count change or make a tally.
I can say who our sale helps.
